summary: @servicetitan/anvil-themes 14.5.9 ships preinstall alternate-runtime dropper executing obfuscated Bun payload
details: Version 14.5.9 of this design-token package adds a preinstall hook ("preinstall": "node setup.mjs") that downloads the Bun runtime from https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases and then uses execFileSync to run a 727KB heavily obfuscated bundled payload, math_init.js, which sits at the tarball root. math_init.js is a single-line `@bun @bun-cjs` bundle using obfuscator.io-style rotated string-array dispatch (WV8StW push/shift over a numeric literal table) that defeats source-level review. Neither setup.mjs nor math_init.js is declared in the package.json `files` array (which lists only `dist` and `readme.md`), and the package's documented purpose is style-dictionary-generated design tokens for iOS/Android, which has no legitimate need for an alternate language runtime or for executing a large obfuscated blob at install. The scope-legitimate package name combined with an injected preinstall dropper is consistent with a compromised-publish / maintainer-token-abuse incident. Installing this version causes automatic execution of attacker-controlled code under a freshly downloaded Bun runtime on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
